translations.1: Then Israel settled in Shittim, and the people began to commit fornication with the daughters of Moab.
translations.2: And they invited the people to the sacrifices of their objects of worship, and they ate of them and bowed down to them.
translations.3: And the house of Israel attached itself to Pe'or the idol, and the anger of God intensified against them.
translations.4: And God said to Moses: 'Take all the chiefs of the people, and crucify them before God facing the sun — that the intensity of God's anger may turn away from the house of Israel.'
translations.5: And Moses said to their judges: 'Let every man in his district kill whoever is attached to Pe'or the idol.'
translations.6: And behold, a man from the sons of Israel had come forward, and brought among them a Midianite woman — in the presence of Moses and their whole assembly, who were weeping at the door of the tent of the convocation.
translations.7: And when Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest saw, he arose from the midst of the assembly, and took a spear in his hand.
translations.8: And he went in after him into the chamber, and thrust both of them through — the man and the woman through her belly — and the pestilence was checked from the sons of Israel.
translations.9: And the number of those who died in that pestilence was twenty-four thousand.
translations.10: Then God spoke to Moses, saying:
translations.11: 'Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest has turned back My wrath from the sons of Israel, in that he was zealous for My sake among them, so that I did not destroy them with My punishment.
translations.12: Therefore say to him: Behold, I am giving him My covenant of peace.
translations.13: And it shall be for him and for his offspring after him a covenant of everlasting priesthood — in recompense for his zeal for his Lord, whereby he made atonement for the sons of Israel.'
translations.14: And the name of the Israelite man who was slain, who was killed with the Midianite woman, was Zimri son of Salu, a noble of his father's house among the Simeonites.
translations.15: And the name of the slain Midianite woman was Cozbi daughter of Zur — he being the head of the people of his nation's household in Midian.
translations.16: Then God spoke to Moses, saying:
translations.17: 'Besiege the Midianites until you have killed them —
translations.18: for they are enemies to you, through their treachery with which they have treacherously dealt against you by reason of Pe'or, and by reason of Cozbi daughter of the noble of Midian their kinswoman, who was slain on the day of the pestilence on account of Pe'or.'
